translations.literal: Now they decline and are exhausted; partisan aid is ruined and thwarted; kin drift apart and rebel; remaining fit fighters number only several hundred; they flee and hide in distant reliance on Fa Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: Today they count hundreds of spears and hide with Fa Qiang.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以为宜及此时，建复西海郡县，规固二榆，广设屯田，隔塞羌胡交关之路，遏绝狂狡窥欲之源。

translations.literal: Your servant foolishly thinks it fitting to seize this moment to restore Western Sea commanderies and counties, fortify the two Elms, broadly establish garrison farms, block the road of Qiang-Hu contact, and choke the spring of wild cunning and greedy desire.
translations.idiomatic: Feng urged restoring Western Sea, farming both Elms, and severing Qiang from Hu.

sentences.zh: 又殖谷富边，省委输之役，国家可以无西方之忧。

translations.literal: Moreover planting grain enriches the frontier and reduces court relay burdens; the state may then lack worry on the west.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier granaries would spare the capital endless convoys.

sentences.zh: ”于是拜凤为金城西部都尉，将徙士屯龙耆。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Feng was appointed western division chief of Jincheng leading relocated militiamen to garrison Longqi.
translations.idiomatic: The throne named Feng western chief of Jincheng at Longqi.

sentences.zh: 后金城长史上官鸿上开置归义、建威屯田二十七部，侯霸复上置东西邯屯田五部，增留、逢二部，帝皆从之。

translations.literal: Later Jincheng senior clerk Shangguan Hong memorialized opening twenty-seven garrison-farm units at Guiyi and Jianwei; Hou Ba again memorialized opening five units at eastern and western Han garrison farms plus two more at Liu and Feng; the emperor assented to all.
translations.idiomatic: Hong and Ba stacked memorials for thirty-four farm belts; the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 列屯夹河，合三十四部。

translations.literal: Garrison colonies lined both banks of the river combining thirty-four divisions.
translations.idiomatic: They planted thirty-four cantonments along the stream.

sentences.zh: 其功垂立。

translations.literal: The achievement hung nearly complete.
translations.idiomatic: Success was within reach.

sentences.zh: 至永初中，诸羌叛。

translations.literal: Down to the early Yongchu era various Qiang rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchu troubles scrapped the plan.

sentences.zh: 乃罢。

translations.literal: It was then abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The colonies were abandoned.

sentences.zh: 迷唐失众，病死。

translations.literal: Mitang lost followers and died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Mitang wasted away and died.

sentences.zh: 有一子来隆，户不满数十。

translations.literal: He had one son Lailong with households fewer than several tens.
translations.idiomatic: Son Lailong kept fewer than a few dozen tents.

sentences.zh: 东号子麻奴立。

translations.literal: Donghao's son Manu succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Manu followed Donghao.

sentences.zh: 初随父降，居安定。

translations.literal: At first he followed his father in surrendering and dwelt in Anding.
translations.idiomatic: He had settled in Anding after his father's capitulation.

sentences.zh: 时，诸降羌布在郡县，皆为吏人豪右所徭役，积以愁怨。

translations.literal: At that time various surrendered Qiang were spread through commanderies and counties and were all corveed by clerks and powerful magnates; resentment piled up.
translations.idiomatic: Scattered Qiang bore corvee for Han gentry until rage boiled.

sentences.zh: 安帝永初元年夏，遣骑都尉王弘发金城、陇西、汉阳羌数百千骑征西域，弘迫促发遣，群羌惧远屯不还，行到酒泉，多有散叛。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Yongchu of Emperor An, Cavalry Commandant Wang Hong mobilized several hundred or thousand horse of surrendered Qiang from Jincheng, Longxi, and Hanyang for the Western Regions campaign; Hong pressed harshly for dispatch; mass Qiang feared distant garrison without return; reaching Jiuquan many scattered and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: An Di Yongchu 1: Wang Hong dragooned plateau Qiang westward; terror sparked mass desertion at Jiuquan.

sentences.zh: 诸郡各发兵徼遮，或覆其庐落。

translations.literal: Each commandery mobilized troops to intercept and cover; some overturned their camps.
translations.idiomatic: Local levies ambushed them and burned camps.

sentences.zh: 于是勒姐、当煎大豪东岸等愈惊，遂同时奔溃。

translations.literal: Thereupon Lejie and Dangjian great chieftains Dong'an and others grew more frightened and simultaneously bolted.
translations.idiomatic: Lejie and Dangjian magnates panicked and ran.

sentences.zh: 麻奴兄弟因此遂与种人俱西出塞。

translations.literal: Manu and his brothers thereby together with tribesmen all went west beyond the pass.
translations.idiomatic: Manu and kin fled west with their bands.

sentences.zh: 先零别种滇零与钟羌诸种大为寇掠，断陇道。

translations.literal: Xianling collateral strain Dianling with Zhong Qiang various strains raided greatly and severed Long roads.
translations.idiomatic: Dianling of Xianling and Zhong allies pillaged and cut the Long corridor.

sentences.zh: 时羌归附既久，无复器甲，或持竹竿木枝以代戈矛，或负板案以为楯，或执铜镜以象兵，郡县畏懦不能制。

translations.literal: At that time Qiang long attached possessed no arms or armor again; some held bamboo poles and wooden branches in place of spear and halberd; some bore plank tables as shields; some grasped bronze mirrors to imitate weapons; commanderies and counties were cowardly and could not control them.
translations.idiomatic: Disarmed Qiang fought with sticks and mirrors while magistrates quailed.

sentences.zh: 冬，遣车骑将军邓骘，征西校尉任尚副，将五营及三河、三辅、汝南、南阳、颍川、太原、上党兵合五万人，屯汉阳。

translations.literal: In winter it dispatched Chariots-and-Cavalry General Deng Zhi with Campaigning-West Colonel Ren Shang vice-commanding five camps plus troops of Three Rivers, Three Assistants, Runan, Nanyang, Yingchuan, Taiyuan, and Shangdang combining fifty thousand men garrisoned at Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Winter sent Deng Zhi and Ren Shang with fifty thousand into Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 明年春，诸郡兵未及至，钟羌数千人先击败骘军于冀西，杀千余人。

translations.literal: The next spring commandery troops had not yet arrived when several thousand Zhong Qiang first defeated Zhi's army west of Ji, killing over a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Before reinforcements landed Zhong fighters shattered Zhi west of Ji.

sentences.zh: 校尉侯霸坐众羌反叛征免，以西域都护段禧代为校尉。

translations.literal: Colonel Hou Ba was summoned and dismissed for fault because mass Qiang rebelled; Western Regions Protector Duan Xi replaced him as colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Ba fell; Duan Xi took the colonelcy.

sentences.zh: 其冬，骘使任尚及从事中郎司马钧率诸郡兵与滇零等数万人战于平襄，尚军大败，死者八千余人。

translations.literal: That winter Zhi sent Ren Shang and staff adviser Sima Jun leading commandery troops to battle several tens of thousands with Dianling and others at Pingxiang; Shang's army was badly defeated with over eight thousand dead.
translations.idiomatic: Winter battle at Pingxiang cost Ren Shang eight thousand.

sentences.zh: 于是滇零等自称“天子”于北地，招集武都、参狼、上郡、西河诸杂种，众遂大盛，东犯赵、魏，南入益州，杀汉中太守董炳，遂寇抄三辅，断陇道。

translations.literal: Thereupon Dianling and others styled themselves Son of Heaven at Beidi, summoned Wudu Canlang, Shangjun, Xihe miscellaneous strains; masses then greatly flourished; eastward they violated Zhao and Wei; southward they entered Yizhou; they killed Hanzhong Governor Dong Bing; then raided Three Assistants and severed Long roads.
translations.idiomatic: Dianling crowned himself at Beidi, rallied plateau tribes, thrust toward Zhao-Wei, Yizhou, and the capital approaches.

sentences.zh: 湟中诸县，粟石万钱，百姓死亡，不可胜数。

translations.literal: In Zhong counties grain reached ten thousand cash per shi; common people died beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong grain hit ten thousand cash the shi; corpses piled beyond count.

sentences.zh: 朝廷不能制，而转运难剧，遂诏骘还师，留任尚屯汉阳，为诸军节度。

translations.literal: The court could not control them while transport grew desperately hard; it therefore ordered Zhi to return the army and left Ren Shang garrisoned at Hanyang as coordinator for various armies.
translations.idiomatic: Logistics broke; Zhi recalled while Shang stayed to direct.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以邓太后故，迎拜骘为大将军，封任尚乐亭侯，食邑三百户。

translations.literal: The court because of Empress Dowager Deng welcomed Zhi as grand general and enfeoffed Ren Shang as marquis of Leting with three hundred households of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: For Deng's sake Zhi became grand general and Shang a modest marquis.

sentences.zh: 三年春，复遣骑都尉任仁督诸郡屯兵救三辅。

translations.literal: In the third year spring it again dispatched Cavalry Commandant Ren Ren to supervise commandery garrison troops rescuing Three Assistants.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchu 3 spring sent Ren Ren to relieve the capital region.

sentences.zh: 仁战每不利，众羌乘胜，汉兵数挫。

translations.literal: Ren's battles were always unfavorable; mass Qiang rode victory; Han troops repeatedly suffered setbacks.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Ren kept losing while Qiang pressed every win.

sentences.zh: 当煎、勒姐种攻没破羌县，钟羌又没临洮县，生得陇西南部都尉。

translations.literal: The Dangjian and Lejie strains attacked and overwhelmed Poqiang County; the Zhong Qiang likewise overwhelmed Lintao County and took alive the western division chief of Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: Dangjian and Lejie wiped out Poqiang while Zhong tribes took Lintao and captured Longxi's western chief alive.

sentences.zh: 明年春，滇零遣人寇褒中，燔烧邮亭，大掠百姓。

translations.literal: The next spring Dianling sent men to raid Baozhong, burned postal relay stations, and plundered the common people on a large scale.
translations.idiomatic: Come spring Dianling's raiders torched Baozhong's post houses and looted the countryside.

sentences.zh: 于是，汉中太守郑勤移屯褒中。

translations.literal: Thereupon Hanzhong Governor Zheng Qin shifted his garrison to Baozhong.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Qin redeployed his camp into Baozhong.

sentences.zh: 军营久出无功，有废农桑，乃诏任尚将吏兵还屯长安，罢遣南阳、颍川、汝南吏士，置京兆虎牙都尉于长安，扶风都尉于雍，如西京三辅都尉故事。

translations.literal: The army had campaigned long without success, wasting farming and sericulture; it therefore ordered Ren Shang to lead clerks and troops back to garrison Chang'an, dismissed Nanyang, Yingchuan, and Runan levies, established the Metropolitan Tiger-Claw Commandant at Chang'an and the Fufeng Commandant at Yong on the model of the Western Capital Three Assistants commandants.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Shang pulled the interior levies home, recreated Chang'an and Yong guard posts like old Western Han practice, and sent farmers back to their fields.

sentences.zh: 时，羌复攻褒中，郑勤欲击之。

translations.literal: At that time Qiang again attacked Baozhong; Zheng Qin wished to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: When Qiang returned to Baozhong, Zheng Qin meant to give battle.

sentences.zh: 主簿段崇谏，以为虏乘胜，锋不可当，宜坚守待之。

translations.literal: Registrar Duan Chong remonstrated, holding that the enemy rode victory and their spearpoint could not be stopped; it was proper to hold firm and await them.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Chong urged a siege mentality: the foe was hot and should be waited out.

sentences.zh: 勤不从，出战，大败，死者三千余人，段崇及门下史王宗、原展以身捍刃，与勤俱死，于是徙金城郡居襄武。

translations.literal: Qin did not obey; he went out to fight and was badly defeated; over three thousand died; Duan Chong and household clerks Wang Zong and Yuan Zhan used their bodies to ward blades and died with Qin; thereupon Jincheng Commandery was moved to dwell at Xiangwu.
translations.idiomatic: Qin sortied, lost three thousand men, and fell with Chong and two aides shielding him; Jincheng's seat shifted to Xiangwu.

sentences.zh: 任仁战累败，而兵士放纵，槛车征诣廷尉诏狱死。

translations.literal: Ren Ren accumulated defeats while his soldiers ran riot; he was summoned in a prisoner cart to the Commandant of Justice's imperial prison and died.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Ren faced court-martial in fetters after mutinous troops and serial losses.

sentences.zh: 段禧病卒，复以前校尉侯霸代之，遂移居张掖。

translations.literal: Duan Xi died of illness; former Colonel Hou Ba again replaced him and moved headquarters to Zhangye.
translations.idiomatic: Xi died; Ba resumed the colonelcy from Zhangye.

sentences.zh: 五年春，任尚坐无功征免。

translations.literal: In the fifth year spring Ren Shang was summoned for lack of achievement and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Spring of year 5 cashiered Ren Shang for futile campaigning.

sentences.zh: 羌遂入寇河东，至河内，百姓相惊，多奔南度河。

translations.literal: Qiang then entered and raided Hedong as far as Henei; common people alarmed one another; many fled south across the river.
translations.idiomatic: The wave rolled into Hedong and Henei; panic drove multitudes south over the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 使北军中候硃宠将五营士屯孟津，诏魏郡、赵国、常山、中山缮作坞候六百一十六所。

translations.literal: It ordered Northern Army middle commander Zhu Chong to lead five-camp soldiers garrisoned at Mengjin; it ordered Wei, Zhao, Changshan, and Zhongshan to repair six hundred sixteen fort-beacon enclosures.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Chong held Mengjin with the northern legions while northern commanderies threw up six hundred sixteen blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 羌既转盛，而二千石、令、长多内郡人，并无守战意，皆争上徙郡县，以避寇难。

translations.literal: Once Qiang grew stronger, two-thousand-bushel officials, magistrates, and chiefs were mostly inner-commandery men without any mind to defend or fight; all vied to memorialize moving commanderies and counties to escape invasion.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier magistrates, mostly inland appointees, sought wholesale relocation rather than resistance.

sentences.zh: 朝廷从之，遂移陇西徙襄武，安定徙美阳，北地徙池阳，上郡徙衙。

translations.literal: The court assented; Longxi moved its seat to Xiangwu, Anding to Meiyang, Beidi to Chiyang, Shangjun to Ya.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved shifting Longxi to Xiangwu, Anding to Meiyang, Beidi to Chiyang, and Shangjun to Ya.

sentences.zh: 百姓恋土，不乐去旧，遂乃刘其禾稼，发彻室屋，夷营壁，破积聚。

translations.literal: Common people loved their soil and were unwilling to leave old lands; officials therefore cut their crops, demolished houses, leveled camp walls, and smashed granaries.
translations.idiomatic: Those who clung to home saw fields slashed and roofs torn down to force the march.

sentences.zh: 时连旱蝗饥荒，而驱踧劫略，流离分散，随道死亡，或弃捐老弱，或为人仆妾，丧其太半。

translations.literal: At that time drought and locusts compounded famine while drives, crushings, and plunder scattered people along roads where they died or cast aside aged and weak or became servants and concubines--more than half were lost.
translations.idiomatic: Drought and locusts met forced evacuation and looting; half the refugees perished or were sold.

sentences.zh: 复以任尚为侍御史，击众羌于上党羊头山，破之，诱杀降者二百余人，乃罢孟津屯。

translations.literal: It again made Ren Shang attendant censor; he attacked mass Qiang at Yangtou Mountain in Shangdang and defeated them; he tricked and killed over two hundred who had surrendered; then the Mengjin garrison was stood down.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Shang crushed Qiang on Yangtou, murdered two hundred surrendered men by ruse, and freed Mengjin.

sentences.zh: 其秋，汉阳人杜琦及弟季贡、同郡王信等与羌通谋，聚众入上邽城，琦自称安汉将军。

translations.literal: That autumn Hanyang native Du Qi, younger brother Ji Gong, and Wang Xin of the same commandery conspired with Qiang, gathered a crowd entering Shanggui city, and Qi styled himself General Who Pacifies Han.
translations.idiomatic: Du Qi, his brother, and Wang Xin seized Shanggui with Qiang help and claimed the title Pacifier of Han.

sentences.zh: 于是诏购募得琦首者，封列侯，赐钱百万，羌胡斩琦者赐金百斤，银二百斤。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict promised whoever delivered Qi's head a full marquisate and a million cash; Qiang or Hu who slew Qi would receive one hundred jin of gold and two hundred jin of silver.
translations.idiomatic: The court priced Qi's head at a marquisate and mountains of gold and silver.

sentences.zh: 汉阳太守赵博遣刺客杜习刺杀琦，封习讨奸侯，赐钱百万。

translations.literal: Hanyang Governor Zhao Bo dispatched assassin Du Xi who stabbed Qi; Xi was enfeoffed as marquis Who Strikes Treason with a million cash.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Bo's blade Du Xi earned a title and purse for killing Qi.

sentences.zh: 而杜季贡、王信等将其众据樗泉营。

translations.literal: But Du Ji Gong and Wang Xin led their followers holding Chuchuan camp.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Gong and Wang Xin still held Chuchuan.

sentences.zh: 侍御史唐喜领诸郡兵讨破之，斩王信等六百余级，没入妻子五百余人，收金银彩帛一亿已上。

translations.literal: Attendant censor Tang Xi led commandery troops, attacked and defeated them, beheaded Wang Xin and over six hundred ranks, confiscated over five hundred wives and children, and seized gold, silver, and colored silks exceeding one hundred million cash.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Xi broke the camp, executed six hundred, and seized immense treasure.

sentences.zh: 杜季贡亡从滇零。

translations.literal: Du Ji Gong fled to join Dianling.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Gong ran to Dianling's camp.

sentences.zh: 六年，任尚复坐征免。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Ren Shang again was summoned for fault and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Year 6 removed Ren Shang again.

sentences.zh: 滇零死，子零昌代立，年尚幼少，同种狼莫为其计策，以杜季贡为将军，别居于奚城。

translations.literal: Dianling died; his son Lingchang succeeded in his place; the boy was still young; Wolf Mo of the same strain devised his strategy; Du Ji Gong was appointed general and dwelt separately at Xi City.
translations.idiomatic: Boy-king Lingchang relied on Wolf Mo and made Ji Gong general at Xi.

sentences.zh: 七年夏，骑都尉马贤与侯霸掩击零昌别部牢羌于安定，首虏千人，得驴、骡、骆驼、马、牛、羊二万余头，以畀得者。

translations.literal: In the seventh year summer Cavalry Commandant Ma Xian with Hou Ba launched a surprise strike against Lingchang's detached Laojie Qiang at Anding, taking a thousand heads and captives, capturing over twenty thousand donkeys, mules, camels, horses, cattle, and sheep, which were given to those who seized them.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xian and Ba ambushed Lingchang's Laojie allies at Anding for a thousand prisoners and massive herds handed out as spoils.

sentences.zh: 元初元年春，遣兵屯河内，通谷冲要三十三所，皆为坞壁，设鸣鼓。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanchu spring it dispatched troops garrisoning Henei; thirty-three choke points through valleys were all walled enclosures with alarm drums.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanchu spring walled thirty-three Henei defiles with signal drums.

sentences.zh: 零昌遣兵寇雍城，又号多与当煎、勒姐大豪共胁诸种，分兵抄掠武都、 汉中。

translations.literal: Lingchang sent troops raiding Yong city; Haoduo further joined great men of Dangjian and Lejie to coerce various strains and divide troops raiding Wudu and Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Lingchang hit Yong while Haoduo bullied allies into pillaging Wudu and Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 巴郡板楯蛮将兵救之，汉中五官掾程信率壮士与蛮共击破之。

translations.literal: The Ban-shield barbarians of Ba Commandery led troops to rescue them; Hanzhong aide Cheng Xin led stalwarts with the barbarians jointly to defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: Ba's shield warriors and Cheng Xin relieved Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 号多退走，还断陇道，与零昌通谋。

translations.literal: Haoduo withdrew, returned to sever the Long route, and conspired with Lingchang.
translations.idiomatic: Haoduo fled north to cut the Long corridor for Lingchang.

sentences.zh: 侯霸、马贤将湟中吏人及降羌胡于枹罕击之，斩首二百余级。

translations.literal: Hou Ba and Ma Xian led Zhong clerks and people plus surrendered Qiang and Hu against them at Fuhan and took over two hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: Ba and Ma Xian struck at Fuhan for two hundred kills.

sentences.zh: 凉州刺史皮杨击羌于狄道，大败，死者八百余人，杨坐征免。

translations.literal: Liangzhou Inspector Pi Yang attacked Qiang at Didao and was badly defeated; over eight hundred died; Yang was summoned and dismissed for fault.
translations.idiomatic: Pi Yang's Didao offensive cost eight hundred lives and his job.

sentences.zh: 侯霸病卒，汉阳太守庞参代为校尉。

translations.literal: Hou Ba died of illness; Hanyang Governor Pang Can replaced him as colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Ba died; Pang Can took the colonelcy.

sentences.zh: 参以恩信招诱之。

translations.literal: Can used kindness and trust to summon and entice them.
translations.idiomatic: Can relied on soft persuasion.

sentences.zh: 二年春，号多等率众七千余人诣参降，遣诣阙，赐号多侯印绶遣之。

translations.literal: In the second year spring Haoduo and others led over seven thousand followers to Pang Can to surrender; they were sent to court; Haoduo was granted marquis seals and ribbons and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Seven thousand followed Haoduo to surrender; the court sealed him and sent him home.

sentences.zh: 参始还居令居，通河西道。

translations.literal: Can first returned to dwell at Lingju and opened the Hexi road.
translations.idiomatic: Can reopened Lingju and traffic into Hexi.

sentences.zh: 而零昌种众复分寇益州，遣中郎将尹就将南阳兵，因发益部诸郡屯兵击零昌党吕叔都等。

translations.literal: But Lingchang's masses again divided to raid Yizhou; it dispatched Palace General Yin Jiang with Nanyang troops and mobilized Yizhou commandery garrison troops to strike Lingchang's partisan Lu Shudu and others.
translations.idiomatic: Lingchang probed Yizhou; Yin Jiang marched Nanyang and provincial garrisons against Lu Shudu.

sentences.zh: 至秋，蜀人陈省、罗横应募，刺杀叔都，皆封侯、赐钱。

translations.literal: Down to autumn Shu men Chen Xing and Luo Heng answered recruitment and assassinated Shudu; both were enfeoffed marquises and granted cash.
translations.idiomatic: Bounty hunters Chen Xing and Luo Heng slew Shudu for titles.

sentences.zh: 又使屯骑校尉班雄屯三辅，遣左冯翊司马钧行征西将军，督右扶风仲光、安定太守杜恢、北地太守盛包、京兆虎牙都尉耿溥、右扶风都尉皇甫旗等，合八千余人，又庞参将羌胡兵七千余人，与钧分道，并北击零昌。

translations.literal: It further ordered Household Rapid-as-Horses Colonel Ban Xiong to garrison Three Assistants; it ordered Left Fengyi Major Sima Jun acting Campaigning-West General overseeing Zhong Guang of right Fufeng, Anding Governor Du Hui, Beidi Governor Sheng Bao, Metropolitan Tiger-Claw Commandant Geng Pu, and right Fufeng Commandant Huangfu Qi and others combining over eight thousand men; moreover Pang Can led seven thousand Qiang and Hu troops; he and Jun took separate routes jointly pressing north against Lingchang.
translations.idiomatic: The court stacked Ban Xiong on the capitalRegion while Jun and Pang Can hammered Lingchang from two roads.

sentences.zh: 参兵至勇士东，为杜季贡所败，于是引退。

translations.literal: Can's troops reached east of Yongshi and were defeated by Du Ji Gong; he therefore withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Can lost to Ji Gong east of Yongshi and fell back.

sentences.zh: 钧等独进，攻拔丁奚城，大克获。

translations.literal: Jun and others advanced alone, attacked and took Dingxi City, and won great captures.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Jun stormed Dingxi with heavy loot.

sentences.zh: 杜季贡率众伪逃。

translations.literal: Du Ji Gong led masses feigning flight.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Gong feigned retreat.

sentences.zh: 钧令光、恢、包等收羌禾稼，光等违钧节度，散兵深入，羌乃设伏要击之。

translations.literal: Jun ordered Guang, Hui, Bao and others to harvest Qiang grain; Guang and others violated Jun's orders, scattered troops deep inward; Qiang then laid ambushes and intercepted them.
translations.idiomatic: Jun's subordinates disobeyed, scattered for grain, and walked into ambush.

sentences.zh: 钧在城中，怒而不救，光等并没，死者三千余人。

translations.literal: Jun was inside the city, angry and refusing rescue; Guang and others were altogether lost; over three thousand died.
translations.idiomatic: Jun sulked in Dingxi while three thousand died outside.

sentences.zh: 钧乃遁还，坐征自杀。

translations.literal: Jun then fled back; summoned for fault he committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: Jun fled, faced impeachment, and killed himself.

sentences.zh: 庞参以失期军败抵罪，以马贤代领校尉事。

translations.literal: Pang Can answered for defeat through missed rendezvous; Ma Xian replaced him in acting colonel affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Can paid for failure; Ma Xian stepped in.

sentences.zh: 后遣任尚为中郎将，将羽林、缇骑、五营子弟三千五百人，代班雄屯三辅。

translations.literal: Later it dispatched Ren Shang as palace general leading Household Guards, palace horse guard, and five-camps youths thirty-five hundred men replacing Ban Xiong garrisoning Three Assistants.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Shang relieved Ban Xiong with thirty-five hundred picked troops.

sentences.zh: 尚临行，怀令虞诩说尚曰：“使君频奉国命，讨逐寇贼，三州屯兵二十余万入，弃农桑，疲苦徭役，而未有功效，劳费日滋。

translations.literal: When Shang was about to depart, Huai County Magistrate Yu Xu told Shang: "You have repeatedly borne imperial orders pursuing bandits; three provinces hold over two hundred thousand troops who abandon farming and suffer exhausting corvee yet achieve nothing while costs daily swell.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xu warned that two hundred thousand idle soldiers were bleeding the realm.

sentences.zh: 若此出不克，诚为使君危之。

translations.literal: If this expedition does not succeed it truly places you in peril.
translations.idiomatic: Another flop would doom Ren Shang.

sentences.zh: ”尚曰：“忧惶久矣，不知所如。

translations.literal: " Shang said: "I have long been anxious and do not know what to do.
translations.idiomatic: Shang confessed he saw no way out.

sentences.zh: ”诩曰：“兵法：弱不攻强，走不逐飞，自然之势也。

translations.literal: " Xu said: "The art of war says the weak does not attack the strong nor running foot chase flying birds--such is nature.
translations.idiomatic: Xu cited the maxim that infantry cannot catch horse nomads.

sentences.zh: 今虏皆马骑，日行数百，来如风雨，去如绝弦。

translations.literal: " Now the enemy are all mounted; they travel several hundred li a day; they come like wind and rain and depart like snapped bowstrings.
translations.idiomatic: Qiang horsemen strike and vanish faster than messengers.

sentences.zh: 以步追之，势不相及，所以旷而无功也。

translations.literal: " To pursue them on foot cannot reach them in speed; therefore campaigns drag fruitlessly.
translations.idiomatic: Foot pursuit explains the stalemate.

sentences.zh: 为使君计者，莫如罢诸郡兵，各令出钱数千，二十人共市一马，如此，可舍甲胄，驰轻兵，以万骑之众，逐数千之虏，追尾掩截，其道自穷。

translations.literal: " For your planning nothing surpasses dismissing commandery levies, ordering each man contribute several thousand cash so twenty men jointly buy one horse; thus they may shed heavy armor, ride light horse, and with ten thousand riders chase several thousand enemies, harrying tails and cutting escape until their road is exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Xu proposed pooling cash for a ten-thousand-horse corps to run the raiders down.

sentences.zh: 便人利事，大功立矣。

translations.literal: " That profits men, suits circumstance, and secures great merit.
translations.idiomatic: Cheap, practical, decisive.

sentences.zh: ”尚大喜，即上言用其计。

translations.literal: " Shang greatly rejoiced and immediately memorialized adopting the plan.
translations.idiomatic: Shang embraced the scheme and memorialized it.

sentences.zh: 乃遣轻骑抄击杜季贡于丁奚城，斩首四百余级，获牛、马、羊数千头。

translations.literal: It then sent light horse raiding Du Ji Gong at Dingxi City, taking over four hundred heads and several thousand cattle, sheep, and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Light cavalry hit Dingxi for four hundred skulls and thousands of stock.

sentences.zh: 明年夏，度辽将军邓遵，率南单于及左鹿蠡王须沈万骑，击零昌于灵州，斩首八百余级。

translations.literal: The next summer General Who Crosses the Liao Deng Zun led the Southern Chanyu and Worthy King of the Left Luxu Shen with ten thousand horse against Lingchang at Lingzhou, taking over eight hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: Next summer Deng Zun and ten thousand Xiongnu allies slaughtered Lingchang at Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 封须沈为破虏侯，金印紫绶，赐金、帛各有差。

translations.literal: Luxu Shen was enfeoffed marquis Who Breaks Barbarians with gold seal and purple ribbon; gold and silk gifts varied by rank.
translations.idiomatic: Shen earned purple ribbon nobility and treasure.

sentences.zh: 任尚遣兵击破先零羌于丁奚城。

translations.literal: Ren Shang dispatched troops defeating Xianling Qiang at Dingxi City.
translations.idiomatic: Shang's column broke Xianling at Dingxi.

sentences.zh: 秋，筑冯翊北界候坞五百所。

translations.literal: In autumn it built five hundred northern-border beacon forts in Fengyi.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn raised five hundred Fengyi watch posts.

sentences.zh: 任尚又遣假司马募陷陈士，击零昌于北地，杀其妻子，得牛、马、羊二万头，烧其庐落，斩首七百余级，得僭号文书及所没诸将印绶。

translations.literal: Ren Shang further dispatched acting major recruiting breach-assault troops who struck Lingchang in Beidi, killed his wife and children, took twenty thousand head of cattle, sheep, and horses, burned his camps, took over seven hundred heads, and captured bogus imperial documents and seized generals' seals and ribbons.
translations.idiomatic: Shang's commandos gutted Lingchang's Beidi base, burned lodges, and seized fake regalia.

sentences.zh: 四年春，尚遣当阗种羌榆鬼等五人刺杀杜季贡，封榆鬼为破羌侯。

translations.literal: In the fourth year spring Shang dispatched Dangtian-strain Qiang Yu Gui and five others to assassinate Du Ji Gong; Yu Gui was enfeoffed marquis Who Breaks Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: Spring year 4: Yu Gui's dagger ended Ji Gong for a marquisate.

sentences.zh: 其夏，尹就以不能定益州，坐征抵罪。

translations.literal: That summer Yin Jiang could not pacify Yizhou and answered for fault by summons.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Jiang failed in Yizhou and faced charges.

sentences.zh: 以益州刺史张乔领尹就军屯，招诱叛羌，稍稍降散。

translations.literal: It ordered Yizhou Inspector Zhang Qiao to take Yin Jiang's army garrison, summon and entice rebel Qiang so they gradually surrendered and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qiao inherited Jiang's camps and talked rebels apart.

sentences.zh: 秋，任尚复募效功种号封刺杀零昌，封号封为羌王。

translations.literal: In autumn Ren Shang again recruited Xiaogong-strain chief Haofeng who assassinated Lingchang; Haofeng was titled Qiang king.
translations.idiomatic: Haofeng murdered Lingchang for the kingship of his band.

sentences.zh: 冬，任尚将诸郡兵与马贤并进北地击狼莫，贤先至安定青石岸，狼莫逆击，败之。

translations.literal: In winter Ren Shang led commandery troops advancing together with Ma Xian north into Beidi against Wolf Mo; Xian first reached Anding at Green Rock Bank where Wolf Mo met and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Winter pincer on Wolf Mo opened with Ma Xian beaten at Green Rock.

sentences.zh: 会尚兵到高平，因合势俱进。

translations.literal: When Shang's troops reached Gaoping they united strength and advanced together.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Shang joined Ma Xian at Gaoping.

sentences.zh: 狼莫等引退，乃转营迫之。

translations.literal: Wolf Mo and others withdrew; they therefore shifted camp pressing them.
translations.idiomatic: Wolf Mo retreated under pursuit.

sentences.zh: 至北地，相持六十余日，战于富平上河，大破之，斩首五千级还，得所略人男女千余人，牛、马、驴、羊、骆驼十余万头。

translations.literal: Reaching Beidi they stalemate sixty-some days then fought at Shanghe in Fuping, crushing them, taking five thousand heads, recovering over a thousand captured men and women and over one hundred thousand livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Sixty days later Fuping's Shanghe battle killed five thousand and freed captives and herds.

sentences.zh: 狼莫逃走，于是西河虔人种羌万一千口诣邓遵降。

translations.literal: Wolf Mo fled; thereupon eleven thousand mouths of Qiang-ren strain of Xihe went to Deng Zun to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Wolf Mo escaped while eleven thousand Xihe Qiang surrendered to Zun.

sentences.zh: 五年，邓遵募上郡全无种羌雕何等刺杀狼莫，赐雕何为羌侯，封遵武阳侯，三千户。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Deng Zun recruited Shangjun Quanwu-strain Qiang Diao He and others who assassinated Wolf Mo; Diao He was granted Qiang marquis; Zun was enfeoffed marquis of Wuyang with three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Year 5: bounty killers slew Wolf Mo; Zun gained three thousand-household nobility.

sentences.zh: 遵以太后从弟故，爵封优大。

translations.literal: Because Zun was Empress Dowager Deng's cousin his noble rank was unusually large.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial kinship inflated Zun's fief.

sentences.zh: 任尚与遵争功，又诈增首级，受赇枉法，臧千万已上，槛车征弃市，没入田卢奴婢财物。

translations.literal: Ren Shang quarreled merit with Zun, further falsely inflated head counts, took bribes and twisted law; illicit gains exceeded ten million cash; he was summoned in a cage cart and executed in the marketplace; fields, houses, slaves, and goods were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Shang forged body counts, took bribes, died in the market, and lost everything.

sentences.zh: 自零昌、狼莫死后，诸羌瓦解，三辅、益州无复寇儆。

translations.literal: After Lingchang and Wolf Mo died various Qiang dissolved; Three Assistants and Yizhou had no further raid alarms.
translations.idiomatic: Their deaths ended alarms in the capital region and southwest.

sentences.zh: 自羌叛十余年间，兵连师老，不暂宁息。

translations.literal: From the rebellion's start through more than ten years armies linked and aged without brief rest.
translations.idiomatic: A decade of war exhausted every army.

sentences.zh: 军旅之费，转运委输，用二百四十余亿，府帑空竭。

translations.literal: Campaign costs and relay transport totaled over twenty-four billion cash; treasury stores emptied.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred forty yi of expenditure drained the vaults.

sentences.zh: 延及内郡，边民死者不可胜数，并、凉二州，遂至虚耗。

translations.literal: It extended into inner commanderies; frontier people died beyond counting; Bing and Liang provinces were hollowed out.
translations.idiomatic: Heartland counties shared the toll; Bing and Liang lay ruined.

sentences.zh: 六年春，勒姐种与陇西种羌号良等通谋欲反，马贤逆击之于安故，斩号良及种人数百级，皆降散。

translations.literal: In the sixth year spring the Lejie strain conspired with Longxi-strain Qiang Haoliang and others intending rebellion; Ma Xian intercepted them at Angu, beheaded Haoliang and several hundred tribesmen; all surrendered and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Spring year 6: Ma Xian crushed a Lejie-Longxi plot at Angu.

sentences.zh: 永宁元年春，上郡沈氐种羌五千余人复寇张掖。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongning spring over five thousand Shenshi-strain Qiang of Shangjun again raided Zhangye.
translations.idiomatic: Yongning spring saw five thousand Shangjun Qiang hit Zhangye.

sentences.zh: 其夏，马贤将万人击之。

translations.literal: That summer Ma Xian led ten thousand men against them.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xian marched ten thousand that summer.

sentences.zh: 初战失利，死者数百人。

translations.literal: The first clash went badly; several hundred died.
translations.idiomatic: First brush cost hundreds.

sentences.zh: 明日复战，破之，斩首千八百级，获生口千余人，马、牛、羊以万数，余虏悉降。

translations.literal: The next day they fought again, broke them, took eighteen hundred heads, over a thousand captives, myriad livestock; remaining enemies all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Day two brought eighteen hundred kills, heavy captures, total surrender.

sentences.zh: 时当煎种大蒙饥五等，以贤兵在张掖，乃乘虚寇金城。

translations.literal: At that time great men of Dangjian strain Mengji Wu and others, because Xian's army was at Zhangye, exploited emptiness to raid Jincheng.
translations.idiomatic: Dangjian magnates struck Jincheng while Xian was east.

sentences.zh: 贤还军追之出塞，斩首数千级而还。

translations.literal: Xian returned his army pursuing beyond the pass, taking several thousand heads before returning.
translations.idiomatic: Xian chased past the wall for several thousand kills.

sentences.zh: 烧当、烧何种闻贤军还，率三千余人复寇张掖，杀长吏。

translations.literal: Shaodang and Shaohe strains hearing Xian's army returned led over three thousand again raiding Zhangye killing senior clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Shaodang and Shaohe raided Zhangye on Xian's return march.

sentences.zh: 初，饥五同种大豪卢怱、忍良等千余户别留允街，而首施两端。

translations.literal: At first Mengji Wu's clansman great men Lu Hu and Ren Liang and others over a thousand households separately stayed at Yunjie hesitating both ways.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Hu and Ren Liang hedged with a thousand tents at Yunjie.

sentences.zh: 建光元年春，马贤率兵召卢{匆心}斩之，因放兵击其种人，首虏二千余人，掠马、牛、羊十万头，忍良等皆亡出塞。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianguang spring Ma Xian led troops summoning Lu Hu (written Lu plus variant graph in text) and executed him; he then unleashed troops against his tribesmen, heads and captives over two thousand, plundering one hundred thousand livestock; Ren Liang and others all fled beyond the pass.
translations.idiomatic: Jianguang spring Ma Xian executed Lu Hu, smashed his kin for two thousand prisoners and vast herds, driving Ren Liang out.

sentences.zh: 玺书封贤安亭侯，食邑千户。

translations.literal: By imperial writing Xian was enfeoffed marquis of Anting with one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Ma Xian Anting marquis at one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 忍良等以麻奴兄弟本烧当世嫡。

translations.literal: Ren Liang and others held that Manu and his brothers were legitimate heirs of the Shaodang line.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Liang insisted Manu's house was true Shaodang royalty.

sentences.zh: 而贤抚恤不至，常有怨心。

translations.literal: Yet Xian's kindness and relief did not reach them; they constantly harbored resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xian's neglect bred grudge.

sentences.zh: 秋，遂相结共胁将诸种步骑三千人寇湟中，攻金城诸县。

translations.literal: In autumn they therefore allied and jointly coerced leading various strains three thousand foot and horse raiding Zhong and attacking Jincheng counties.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn they dragged three thousand fighters through Zhong against Jincheng.

sentences.zh: 贤将先零种赴击之，战于牧苑，兵败，死者四百余人。

translations.literal: Xian led Xianling-strain troops to strike them; they fought at Shepherd Pastures; the army was defeated; over four hundred died.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xian's Xianling contingent lost four hundred at the imperial pasture.

sentences.zh: 麻奴等又败武威、张掖郡兵于令居，因胁将先零、沈氐诸种四千余户，缘山西走，寇武威。

translations.literal: Manu and others further defeated Wuwei and Zhangye commandery troops at Lingju, then coerced leading Xianling and Shenshi strains over four thousand households along the mountains westward raiding Wuwei.
translations.idiomatic: They crushed Lingju garrisons and marched four thousand tents west against Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 贤追到鸾鸟，招引之。

translations.literal: Xian pursued to Luanniao and summoned them.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xian caught them at Luanniao with offers.

sentences.zh: 诸种降者数千，麻奴南还湟中。

translations.literal: Several thousand strains surrendered; Manu returned south to Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: Thousands yielded; Manu slipped back into Zhong.

sentences.zh: 延光元年春，贤追到湟中，麻奴出塞度河。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yanguang spring Xian pursued into Zhong; Manu exited the pass crossing the river.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang spring Ma Xian drove Manu across the river.

sentences.zh: 贤复追击，战破之，种众散遁，诣凉州刺史宗汉降。

translations.literal: Xian pursued again, attacked and defeated them; tribal masses scattered and fled to Liangzhou Inspector Zong Han to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xian broke them again; survivors sued Zong Han.

sentences.zh: 麻奴等孤弱饥困，其年冬，将种众三千余户诣汉阳太守耿种降。

translations.literal: Manu and others isolated, weak, hungry, and exhausted that winter led over three thousand households to Hanyang Governor Geng Zhong to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Winter hunger brought three thousand tents to Geng Zhong.

sentences.zh: 安帝假金印紫绶，赐金银彩缯各有差。

translations.literal: Emperor An granted temporary gold seal and purple ribbon; gold, silver, and colored silks varied by recipient.
translations.idiomatic: An Di awarded gold seals, silver, and silks by rank.

sentences.zh: 是岁，虔人种羌与上郡胡反，攻穀罗城。

translations.literal: That year Qian-strain Qiang together with Shangjun Hu rebelled and attacked Gulu City.
translations.idiomatic: Qian-strain Qiang joined Shangjun Hu to storm Gulu.

sentences.zh: 度辽将军耿夔将诸郡兵及乌桓骑赴，击破之。

translations.literal: General Who Crosses the Liao Geng Kui led commandery troops and Wuhuan horse to hurry there, attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Kui rode in with levies and Wuhuan cavalry and broke the siege.

sentences.zh: 三年秋，陇西郡始还狄道焉。

translations.literal: In the third year autumn Longxi Commandery first returned to Didao.
translations.idiomatic: Longxi's seat moved back to Didao that autumn.

sentences.zh: 麻奴弟犀苦立。

translations.literal: Manu's younger brother Xiku succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Xiku followed Manu.

sentences.zh: 顺帝永建元年，陇西钟羌反。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongjian of Emperor Shun the Zhong Qiang of Longxi rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Shun's Yongjian 1 saw Longxi Zhong rise.

sentences.zh: 校尉马贤将七千余人击之，战于临洮，斩首千余级，皆率种人降。

translations.literal: Colonel Ma Xian led over seven thousand against them; they fought at Lintao; he took over a thousand heads and they all led tribesmen to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xian killed a thousand at Lintao and accepted total surrender.

sentences.zh: 进封贤都乡侯，自是凉州无事。

translations.literal: He was advanced to village marquis of Du; from this Liangzhou had no further incidents.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xian earned Du village nobility and Liangzhou quieted.

sentences.zh: 至四年，尚书仆射虞诩上疏曰：“臣闻子孙以奉祖为孝，君上以安民为明，此高宗、周宣所以上配汤、武也。

translations.literal: Down to the fourth year Supervisor of the Masters of Writing Yu Xu submitted: "Your servant has heard that sons and grandsons take serving ancestors as filial piety and sovereigns take pacifying the people as clarity of rule; this is how Gaozong and King Xuan of Zhou matched Tang and Wu above."
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xu argued that restoring the northwest honored ancestors like Gaozong and Zhou Xuan.

sentences.zh: 《禹贡》雍州之域，厥田惟上。

translations.literal: The "Tribute of Yu" lands of Yongzhou—their fields rank highest.
translations.idiomatic: The "Tribute of Yu" calls Yongzhou soil top grade.

sentences.zh: 且沃野千里，谷稼殷积，又有龟兹盐池，以为民利。

translations.literal: Moreover there are a thousand li of fertile wilds with grain piled rich and further Kuqa salt ponds benefiting the people.
translations.idiomatic: Rich soil, full granaries, and brine pools fed the realm.

sentences.zh: 水草丰美，土宜产牧，牛马衔尾，群羊塞道。

translations.literal: Water and grass are lush; the soil suits herding; cattle and horses tail-link; flocks block the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Pasture ran thick with herds nose-to-tail.

sentences.zh: 北阻山河，乘厄据险。

translations.literal: Northward mountains and rivers block; they rely on narrows and hold dangers.
translations.idiomatic: Northern heights and defiles formed natural ramparts.

sentences.zh: 因渠以溉，水舂河漕。

translations.literal: They use canals for irrigation; water mills grind grain and river transport moves tribute grain.
translations.idiomatic: Canals irrigated fields while mills and river barges fed the camps cheaply.

sentences.zh: 用功省少，而军粮饶足。

translations.literal: Labor spent is slight yet army grain abounds.
translations.idiomatic: Little labor bought abundant rations.

sentences.zh: 故孝武皇帝及光武筑朔方，开西河，置上郡，皆为此也。

translations.literal: Therefore Emperor Wu of Filial Piety and Guangwu built Shuofang, opened Xihe, and established Shangjun—all for this.
translations.idiomatic: Han Wu and Guangwu colonized the north for those reasons.

sentences.zh: 而遭元元无妄之灾，众羌内溃，郡县兵荒，二十余年。

translations.literal: Yet they met common folk's unforeseen calamity; mass Qiang collapsed inward; commanderies and counties knew weapon famine over twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty years of Qiang revolt wasted those gains.

sentences.zh: 夫弃沃壤之饶，损自然之财，不可谓利；

translations.literal: As for abandoning rich fertile soil and diminishing nature's wealth—this cannot be called profit;
translations.idiomatic: To surrender rich ground is no gain;

sentences.zh: 离河山之阻，守无险之处，难以为固。

translations.literal: to leave river-and-mountain barriers and guard places without narrows is hard to make secure.
translations.idiomatic: to abandon natural walls invites invasion.

sentences.zh: 今三郡未复，园陵单外，而公卿选懦，容头过身，张解设难，但计所费，不图其安。

translations.literal: Now three commanderies are not restored; imperial tombs stand solitary outside while dukes and ministers choose cowardice, barely squeezing past blame, spreading excuses and posing objections, reckoning only expense and not plotting security.
translations.idiomatic: Three northwest commands stayed empty near royal tombs while ministers counted coins and dodged duty.

sentences.zh: 宜开圣德，考行所长。

translations.literal: It is fitting to unfold sagely virtue and examine what practices excel.
translations.idiomatic: The throne should weigh real strengths.

sentences.zh: ”书奏，帝乃复三郡。

translations.literal: " When the memorial arrived the emperor restored the three commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor restored Anding, Beidi, and Shangjun on Xu's plea.

sentences.zh: 使谒者郭璜督促徙者，各归旧县，缮城郭，置候驿。

translations.literal: It ordered Herald Guo Huang to hurry migrants each returning to old counties, repairing walls, establishing beacon relays.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Huang shepherded refugees home to rebuild walls and posts.

sentences.zh: 既而激河浚渠，为屯田，省内郡费岁一亿计。

translations.literal: Soon they dredged channels beside the river for garrison farms, saving inner commanderies upward of one hundred million cash yearly.
translations.idiomatic: River works and farms saved the interior a yi yearly.

sentences.zh: 遂令安定、北地、上郡及陇西、金城常储谷粟，令周数年。

translations.literal: Thereupon it ordered Anding, Beidi, Shangjun plus Longxi and Jincheng constantly to stockpile grain and millet enough for several years.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier bins were ordered filled for multi-year subsistence.

sentences.zh: 马贤以犀苦兄弟数背叛，因系质于令居。

translations.literal: Ma Xian because Xiku and brothers repeatedly rebelled detained them as hostages at Lingju.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xian held Xiku's kin hostage at Lingju for serial betrayals.

sentences.zh: 其冬，贤坐征免，右扶风韩皓代为校尉。

translations.literal: That winter Xian was summoned for fault and dismissed; Han Hao of right Fufeng replaced him as colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Xian fell; Han Hao became colonel.

sentences.zh: 明年，犀苦诣皓，自言求归故地。

translations.literal: The next year Xiku visited Hao speaking on his own behalf requesting return to former lands.
translations.idiomatic: Next year Xiku asked Hao to let him go home.

sentences.zh: 皓复不遣，因转湟中屯田，置两河间，以逼群羌。

translations.literal: Hao again refused to release him and therefore shifted Zhong garrison farms between the two rivers to press mass Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: Hao wedged military colonies between the Huang loops to squeeze the tribes.

sentences.zh: 皓复坐征，张掖太守马续代为校尉。

translations.literal: Hao again was summoned for fault; Ma Xu of Zhangye replaced him as colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Hao fell; Ma Xu succeeded.

sentences.zh: 两河间羌以屯田近之，恐必见图，乃解仇诅盟，各自儆备。

translations.literal: Qiang between the two rivers because garrison farms drew near feared certain plotting against them; they therefore broke old grudges, swore blood oath, and each readied defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Twin-river Qiang feared the colonies and armed every camp.

sentences.zh: 续欲先示恩信，乃上移屯田还湟中，羌意乃安。

translations.literal: Xu wished first to display kindness and trust; he therefore memorialized moving garrison farms back to Zhong; Qiang intentions then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Xu pulled colonies back into Zhong and eased tribal fears.

sentences.zh: 至阳嘉元年，以湟中地广，更增置屯田五部，并为十部。

translations.literal: Down to the first year of Yangjia because Zhong ground was broad he further added five garrison-farm divisions making ten.
translations.idiomatic: Yangjia 1 expanded Zhong farms to ten divisions.

sentences.zh: 二年夏，夏置陇西南部都尉如旧制。

translations.literal: In the second year summer he again established Longxi western division chief per old regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Summer year 2 restored Longxi's western chief.

sentences.zh: 三年，钟羌良封等复寇陇西、汉阳，诏拜前校尉马贤为谒者，镇抚诸种。

translations.literal: In the third year Zhong Qiang Liangfeng and others again raided Longxi and Hanyang; an edict appointed former Colonel Ma Xian herald to pacify various strains.
translations.idiomatic: Year 3 Liangfeng struck Longxi and Hanyang; Ma Xian became herald-conciliator.

sentences.zh: 马续遣兵击良封，斩首数百级。

translations.literal: Ma Xu sent troops against Liangfeng taking several hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xu clipped Liangfeng for several hundred kills.

sentences.zh: 四年，马贤亦发陇西吏士及羌胡兵击杀良封，斩首千八百级，获马、牛、羊五万余头。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Ma Xian also mobilized Longxi clerks and soldiers plus Qiang and Hu troops killing Liangfeng with eighteen hundred heads and over fifty thousand livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Year 4 Ma Xian added eighteen hundred kills and vast herds.

sentences.zh: 良封亲属并诣贤降。

translations.literal: Liangfeng's kin all went to Ma Xian to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: His clan capitulated to Xian.

sentences.zh: 贤复进击钟羌且昌，且昌等率诸种十余万诣凉州刺史降。

translations.literal: Xian further advanced against Zhong Qiang Qiechang; Qiechang and others led various strains over one hundred thousand to Liangzhou Inspector to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Xian pushed Qiechang until a hundred thousand yielded to the inspector.

sentences.zh: 永和元年，马续迁度辽将军，复以马贤代为校尉。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yonghe Ma Xu was promoted General Who Crosses the Liao; Ma Xian again replaced him as colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Yonghe 1 promoted Xu; Ma Xian returned as colonel.

sentences.zh: 初，武都塞上白马羌攻破屯官，反叛连年。

translations.literal: At first White Horse Qiang on Wudu barrier broke garrison officials rebelling year after year.
translations.idiomatic: White Horse Qiang on Wudu's wall had long raided colony officers.

sentences.zh: 二年春，广汉属国都尉击破之，斩首六百余级，马贤又击斩其渠帅饥指累祖等三百级，于是陇右复平。

translations.literal: In the second year spring the dependent-state commandant of Guanghan defeated them taking over six hundred heads; Ma Xian further struck and beheaded their chiefs Jizhileizu and others three hundred ranks; thereupon Longyou was again pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Spring year 2 smashed White Horse bands for nine hundred heads total.

sentences.zh: 明年冬，烧当种那离等三千余骑寇金城塞，马贤将兵赴击，斩首四百余级，获马千四百匹。

translations.literal: The next winter Shaodang-strain Nali and others over three thousand horse raided Jincheng barrier; Ma Xian led troops to strike taking over four hundred heads and fourteen hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: Next winter Nali hit Jincheng; Ma Xian took four hundred skulls.

sentences.zh: 那离等复西招羌胡，杀伤吏民。

translations.literal: Nali and others again summoned Qiang and Hu westward killing and wounding clerks and people.
translations.idiomatic: Nali rallied western allies and killed Han subjects.

sentences.zh: 四年，马贤将湟中义从兵及羌胡万余骑掩击那离等，斩之，获首虏千二百余级，得马、骡、羊十万余头。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Ma Xian led Zhong volunteer troops and Qiang and Hu over ten thousand horse in surprise strike against Nali and others, executed him, took heads and captives over twelve hundred, and gained over one hundred thousand horses, mules, and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Year 4 Ma Xian ambushed Nali for twelve hundred prisoners and huge flocks.

sentences.zh: 征贤为弘农太守，以来机为并州刺史，刘秉为凉州刺史，并当之职。

translations.literal: Ma Xian was summoned as governor of Hongnong; Lai Ji was made Bingzhou inspector and Liu Bing Liangzhou inspector to assume those posts.
translations.idiomatic: Xian went to Hongnong; Ji and Bing took the provinces.

sentences.zh: 大将军梁商谓机等曰：“戎狄荒服，蛮夷要服，言其荒忽无常。

translations.literal: Grand General Liang Shang told Ji and others: "Rong and Di are wild domains; Man and Yi are cord domains—the saying means they are wild and shifting without constancy.
translations.idiomatic: Shang lectured the new inspectors that barbarians are fickle.

sentences.zh: 而统领之道，亦无常法，临事制宜，略依其俗。

translations.literal: Yet the way to oversee them also lacks fixed law; facing affairs establish measures and broadly follow their customs.
translations.idiomatic: Rule must adapt to frontier habits.

sentences.zh: 今三君素性疾恶，欲分明白黑。

translations.literal: Now you three gentlemen by nature hate evil and wish to divide black from white.
translations.idiomatic: But Ji, Bing, and company loved harsh clarity.

sentences.zh: 孔子曰：‘人而不仁，疾之已甚，乱也。

translations.literal: Confucius said: 'As for men lacking benevolence, if you hate them excessively there is turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius warned that excessive hatred of the base breeds chaos

sentences.zh: ’况戎狄乎！

translations.literal: ' How much more Rong and Di!
translations.idiomatic: —how much more steppe peoples.

sentences.zh: 其务安羌胡，防其大故，忍其小过。

translations.literal: ' Secure Qiang and Hu, guard against great crises, endure petty faults.
translations.idiomatic: Shang urged tolerance of small slips while checking big threats.

sentences.zh: ”机等天性虐刻，遂不能从。

translations.literal: " Yet Ji and others by nature were cruel and harsh and ultimately could not obey.
translations.idiomatic: The inspectors ignored him.

sentences.zh: 到州之日，多所扰发。

translations.literal: On reaching their provinces they stirred trouble widely.
translations.idiomatic: Their arrival meant fresh oppression.

sentences.zh: 五年夏，且冻、傅难种羌等遂反叛，攻金城，与西塞及湟中杂种羌胡大寇三辅，杀害长吏。

translations.literal: In the fifth year summer Qiedong and Funan-strain Qiang and others then rebelled attacking Jincheng and together with western-barrier and Zhong miscellaneous Qiang and Hu raided Three Assistants greatly killing senior clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Summer year 5 united plateau tribes stormed Jincheng and the capital approaches.

sentences.zh: 机、秉并坐征。

translations.literal: Ji and Bing were both summoned for fault.
translations.idiomatic: Both inspectors were cashiered.

sentences.zh: 于是发京师近郡及诸州兵讨之，拜马贤为征西将军，以骑都尉耿叔副，将左右羽林、五校士及诸州郡兵十万人屯汉阳。

translations.literal: Thereupon it mobilized capital vicinity commanderies and various provincial troops to punish them; Ma Xian was appointed Campaigning-West General with Cavalry Commandant Geng Shu vice-commanding Household Guards, five camps, and provincial-commandery troops one hundred thousand garrisoned at Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xian took a hundred thousand men into Hanyang with Geng Shu.

sentences.zh: 又于扶风、汉阳、陇道作坞壁三百所，置屯兵，以保聚百姓。

translations.literal: Moreover it built three hundred fortress enclosures on Fufeng, Hanyang, and Long roads placing garrison troops to protect and gather common people.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred blockhouses shielded Fufeng-Hanyang-Long.

sentences.zh: 且冻分遣种人寇武都，烧陇关，掠苑马。

translations.literal: Qiedong separately dispatched tribesmen raiding Wudu, burning Long Pass, plundering pasture horses.
translations.idiomatic: Qiedong burned Long gate and stole stud mounts.

sentences.zh: 六年春，马贤将五六千骑击之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year spring Ma Xian led five or six thousand horse against them.
translations.idiomatic: Spring year 6 Ma Xian rode with six thousand.

sentences.zh: 到射姑山，贤军败，贤及二子皆战殁。

translations.literal: Reaching Shegu Mountain Xian's army was defeated; Xian and two sons all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: At Shegu Mountain Ma Xian and his sons fell.

sentences.zh: 顺帝愍之，赐布三千匹，谷千斛，封贤孙光为舞阳亭侯，租入岁百万。

translations.literal: Emperor Shun pitied him granting three thousand bolts cloth, one thousand hu grain, enfeoffing Xian's grandson Guang marquis of Wuyang village with yearly rent income one million.
translations.idiomatic: Shun ennobled grandson Guang and granted burial gifts.

sentences.zh: 遣侍御史督录征西营兵，存恤死伤。

translations.literal: It dispatched attendant censors to supervise recording Campaigning-West camp troops and relieve dead and wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Censors audited casualties and relief.

sentences.zh: 于是东西羌遂大合。

translations.literal: Thereupon eastern and western Qiang greatly united.
translations.idiomatic: East and west Qiang fused into one storm.

sentences.zh: 巩唐种三千余骑寇陇西，又烧园陵，掠关中，杀伤长吏。

translations.literal: Gongtang-strain over three thousand horse raided Longxi; moreover burned imperial parks and tombs, plundered Guanzhong, killing and wounding senior clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Gongtang burned tombs and ravaged Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 郃阳令任頵追击，战死。

translations.literal: Heyang Magistrate Ren Yin pursued and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Yin died chasing them.

sentences.zh: 遣中郎将庞浚募勇士千五百人顿美阳，为凉州援。

translations.literal: It dispatched Palace General Pang Jun recruiting fifteen hundred stalwarts stationed at Meiyang as Liangzhou relief.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Jun held Meiyang with picked men.

sentences.zh: 武威太守赵冲追击巩唐羌，斩首四百余级，得马、牛、羊、驴万八千余头，羌二千余人降。

translations.literal: Wuwei Governor Zhao Chong pursued Gongtang Qiang taking over four hundred heads, eighteen thousand livestock, two thousand Qiang surrendering.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Chong broke Gongtang for four hundred kills.

sentences.zh: 诏冲督河西四郡兵为节度。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Chong to supervise Hexi four-commandery troops as coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: Chong coordinated Hexi.

sentences.zh: 罕种羌千余寇北地，北地太守贾福与赵冲击之，不利。

translations.literal: Han-strain Qiang over a thousand raided Beidi; Beidi Governor Jia Fu with Zhao Chong struck them without success.
translations.idiomatic: Han Qiang probed Beidi to Fu's cost.

sentences.zh: 秋，诸种八九千骑寇武威，凉部震恐。

translations.literal: In autumn various strains eight or nine thousand horse raided Wuwei; Liangzhou department trembled in fear.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn brought nine thousand riders against Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 于是复徙安定居扶风，北地居冯翊，遣行车骑将军执金吾张乔将左右羽林、五校士及河内、南阳、汝南兵万五千屯三辅。

translations.literal: Thereupon Anding was again moved to dwell in Fufeng and Beidi in Fengyi; Acting Chariots-and-Cavalry General Bearer of the Golden Mallet Zhang Qiao led Household Guards, five camps, and Henei, Nanyang, Runan troops fifteen thousand garrisoning Three Assistants.
translations.idiomatic: Command seats slid east again while Zhang Qiao held the capital region.

sentences.zh: 汉安元年，以赵冲为护羌校尉。

translations.literal: In the first year of Han'an Zhao Chong was made Colonel Protector of Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: Han'an 1 named Chong colonel.

sentences.zh: 冲招怀叛羌，罕种乃率邑落五千余户诣冲降。

translations.literal: Chong summoned and cherished rebel Qiang; Han strain then led camp settlements over five thousand households to Chong to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Chong's patience brought five thousand Han tents.

sentences.zh: 于是罢张乔军屯。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zhang Qiao's army garrison was stood down.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qiao's levy went home.

sentences.zh: 唯烧何种三千余落据参读北界。

translations.literal: Only Shaohe strain over three thousand settlements held Canlan north border.
translations.idiomatic: Only Shaohe clung to Canlan.

sentences.zh: 三年夏，赵冲与汉阳太守张贡掩击之，斩首千五百级，得牛、羊、驴十八万头。

translations.literal: In the third year summer Zhao Chong with Hanyang Governor Zhang Gong surprise-struck them taking fifteen hundred heads and one hundred eighty thousand cattle, sheep, and donkeys.
translations.idiomatic: Summer year 3 Chong and Gong killed fifteen hundred at Canlan.

sentences.zh: 冬，冲击诸种，斩首四千余级。

translations.literal: In winter Chong struck various strains taking over four thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: Winter added four thousand kills.

sentences.zh: 诏冲一子为郎。

translations.literal: An edict made one of Chong's sons a gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: A Chong son entered the palace corps.

sentences.zh: 冲复追击于阿阳，斩首八百级。

translations.literal: Chong pursued again at Ayang taking eight hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: Ayang pursuit yielded eight hundred.

sentences.zh: 于是诸种前后三万余户诣凉州刺史降。

translations.literal: Thereupon various strains successively over thirty thousand households went to Liangzhou Inspector to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty thousand households yielded to the inspector.

sentences.zh: 建康元年春，护羌从事马玄遂为诸羌所诱，将羌众亡出塞。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiankang spring aide Protecting Qiang Ma Xuan was enticed by various Qiang leading Qiang masses fleeing beyond the pass.
translations.idiomatic: Jiankang spring Ma Xuan deserted with tribes.

sentences.zh: 领护羌校尉卫瑶追击玄等，斩首八百余级，得牛、马、羊二十余万头。

translations.literal: Acting Colonel Protecting Qiang Wei Yao pursued Xuan and others taking eight hundred heads and two hundred thousand livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yao reclaimed eight hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 赵冲复追叛羌到建威亶阴河。

translations.literal: Zhao Chong again pursued rebel Qiang to Jianwei Dunyin River.
translations.idiomatic: Chong chased rebels to Dunyin.

sentences.zh: 军度未竟，所将降胡六百余人叛走，冲将数百人追之，遇羌伏兵，与战殁。

translations.literal: The army had not finished crossing when over six hundred surrendered Hu he led rebelled and fled; Chong led several hundred pursuing them, met Qiang ambush, and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Mid-river Hu mutiny lured Chong into an ambush.

sentences.zh: 冲虽身死，而前后多所斩获，羌由是衰耗。

translations.literal: Although Chong died personally before and after there were many captures and kills; Qiang thereby declined and exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Chong's campaigns still broke Qiang strength.

sentences.zh: 永嘉元年，封冲子恺义阳亭侯。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongjia one of Chong's sons Kai was enfeoffed village marquis of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yongjia ennobled Kai.

sentences.zh: 以汉阳太守张贡代为校尉。

translations.literal: Hanyang Governor Zhang Gong replaced him as colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Gong became colonel.

sentences.zh: 左冯翊梁並稍以恩信招诱之，于是离湳、狐奴等五万余户诣並降，陇右复平。

translations.literal: Left Fengyi Liang Bing gradually used kindness and trust to summon them; thereupon Linan, Hunu, and others over fifty thousand households went to Bing to surrender; Longyou was again pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Bing talked fifty thousand tents down.

sentences.zh: 並，大将军冀之宗人。

translations.literal: Bing was a clansman of Grand General Liang Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Bing belonged to Liang Ji's kin.

sentences.zh: 封为鄠侯，邑二千户。

translations.literal: He was enfeoffed marquis of Hu with two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Hu marquisate at two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 自永和羌叛，至乎是岁，十余年间，费用八十余亿。

translations.literal: From Yonghe Qiang rebellion down to this year over ten years expense ran eighty billion cash.
translations.idiomatic: Ten Yonghe-year campaigns cost eight yi.

sentences.zh: 诸将多断盗牢禀，私自润入，皆以珍宝货赂左右，上下放纵，不恤军事，士卒不得其死者，白骨相望于野。

translations.literal: Many generals embezzled prison grain and supplies lining private pockets; all used gems and treasures bribing those around the throne; high and low ran unchecked caring nothing for military affairs; soldiers who met unjust deaths—white bones faced one another in the wilds.
translations.idiomatic: Generals stole pay while corpses littered the frontier.

sentences.zh: 桓帝建和二年，白马羌寇广汉属国，杀长吏。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianhe of Emperor Huan White Horse Qiang raided Guanghan dependent state killing senior clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Di Jianhe 2 White Horse struck Guanghan.

sentences.zh: 是时西羌及湟中胡复畔为寇，益州刺史率板楯蛮讨破之，斩首招降二十万人。

translations.literal: At that time western Qiang and Zhong Hu again rebelled as raiders; Yizhou Inspector led Ban-shield barbarians defeating them taking heads and summoning surrender two hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Ban shields cleared two hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 永寿元年，校尉张贡卒，以前南阳太守第五访代为校尉，甚有威惠，西垂无事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongshou Colonel Zhang Gong died; former Nanyang Governor Di Fang replaced him as colonel with great awe and kindness; the western marches were quiet.
translations.idiomatic: Di Fang's colonelcy brought peace.

sentences.zh: 延熹二年，访卒，以中郎将段颎代为校尉。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yanxi Fang died; Palace General Duan Jiong replaced him as colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Yanxi 2 brought Duan Jiong.

sentences.zh: 时烧当八种寇陇右，颎击大破之。

translations.literal: At that time eight Shaodang strains raided Longyou; Jiong struck and greatly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Jiong shattered eight Shaodang bands.

sentences.zh: 四年，零吾复与先零及上郡沈氐、牢姐诸种并力寇并、 凉及三辅。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Lingwu again with Xianling and Shangjun Shenshi, Laojie various strains jointly raided Bing, Liang, and Three Assistants.
translations.idiomatic: Year 4 Lingwu allied plateau tribes against Bing-Liang-capital.

sentences.zh: 会段颎坐事征，以济南相胡闳代为校尉。

translations.literal: When Duan Jiong answered for an affair and was summoned Hu Hong of Jinan replaced him as colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Jiong fell; Hu Hong succeeded.

sentences.zh: 闳无威略，羌遂陆梁，覆没营坞，寇患转盛，中郎将皇甫规击破之。

translations.literal: Hong lacked awe and strategy; Qiang therefore rampaged, overwhelmed camps and forts, raid calamity turned greater; Palace General Huangfu Gui defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Hong failed; Huangfu Gui turned the tide.

sentences.zh: 五年，沈氐诸种复寇张掖、酒泉，皇甫规招之，皆降。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Shenshi various strains again raided Zhangye and Jiuquan; Huangfu Gui summoned them and all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Shenshi riders struck Zhangye and Jiuquan until Huangfu Gui summoned every band to lay down arms.

sentences.zh: 事已具《规传》。

translations.literal: The affair is fully given in the "Biography of Gui".
translations.idiomatic: The campaign is narrated in Huangfu Gui's memoir.

sentences.zh: 鸟吾种复寇汉阳，陇西、金城诸郡兵共击破之，各还降附。

translations.literal: The Niaowu strain again raided Hanyang; Longxi and Jincheng commandery troops jointly defeated them; each returned in surrender and attachment.
translations.idiomatic: Combined Longxi and Jincheng forces broke Niaowu at Hanyang and received their submission.

sentences.zh: 至冬，滇那等五六千人复攻武威、张掖、酒泉，烧民庐舍。

translations.literal: Down to winter Dianna and others five or six thousand again attacked Wuwei, Zhangye, and Jiuquan, burning commoners' houses.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Dianna led five or six thousand men to burn settlements across Hexi.

sentences.zh: 六年，陇西太守孙羌击破之，斩首溺死三千余人。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Longxi Governor Sun Qiang defeated them, taking over three thousand beheaded or drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Qiang of Longxi drowned or beheaded more than three thousand of them in year six.

sentences.zh: 胡闳疾，复以段颎为校尉。

translations.literal: Hu Hong fell ill; Duan Jiong again became colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Ailing Hu Hong yielded his colonel's baton back to Duan Jiong.

sentences.zh: 永康元年，东羌岸尾等胁同种连寇三辅，中郎将张奂追，破斩之，事已具《奂传》。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongkang eastern Qiang Anwei and others coerced tribes of their kind to raid Three Assistants in succession; Palace General Zhang Huan pursued, defeated, and beheaded them; the affair is fully given in the "Biography of Huan".
translations.idiomatic: Yongkang 1: Zhang Huan ran down eastern Qiang who had plagued the capital approaches—see his biography.

sentences.zh: 当煎羌寇武威，破羌将军段颎复破灭之，余悉降散。

translations.literal: Dangjian Qiang raided Wuwei; General Who Breaks Qiang Duan Jiong again destroyed them; the remainder all surrendered and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Jiong shattered Dangjian outside Wuwei and dispersed the survivors.

sentences.zh: 事已具《颎传》。

translations.literal: The affair is fully given in the "Biography of Jiong".
translations.idiomatic: Full detail sits in Duan Jiong's memoir.

sentences.zh: 灵帝建宁三年，烧当羌奉使贡献。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianning of Emperor Ling Shaodang Qiang sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ling Di's third Jianning year brought Shaodang envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 中平元年，北地降羌先零种因黄巾大乱，乃与湟中羌、义从胡北宫伯玉等反，寇陇右。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhongping surrendered Beidi Qiang of Xianling strain, because of Yellow Turban great turmoil, then rebelled together with Zhong Qiang and volunteer Hu Beigong Boyu and others, raiding Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongping chaos let Xianling Qiang, Zhong tribes, and Boyu's Hu seize Longyou together.

sentences.zh: 事已见《董卓传》。

translations.literal: The affair is already seen in the "Biography of Dong Zhuo".
translations.idiomatic: Dong Zhuo's biography carries what followed.

sentences.zh: 兴平元年，冯翊降羌反，寇诸县，郭汜、樊稠击破之，斩首数千级。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xingping surrendered Fengyi Qiang rebelled, raiding various counties; Guo Si and Fan Chou defeated them, taking several thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: Xingping saw Guo Si and Fan Chou crush Fengyi Qiang raiders by thousands.

sentences.zh: 自爰剑后，子孙支分，凡百五十种。

translations.literal: From Yuanjian onward descendants branched apart—altogether one hundred fifty strains.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjian's descendants divided into a hundred fifty named branches.

sentences.zh: 其九种在赐支河首以西，及在蜀、汉徼北，前史不载口数。

translations.literal: Nine strains dwell west of the Zhizhi headwaters and north of the outer marches of Shu and Han; earlier histories record no population counts.
translations.idiomatic: Nine bands lived beyond Zhizhi and north of Shu-Han frontiers without census figures.

sentences.zh: 唯参狼在武都，胜兵数千人。

translations.literal: Only Canlang in Wudu had several thousand fit warriors.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Canlang at Wudu fielded a few thousand fighters.

sentences.zh: 其五十二种衰少，不能自立，分散为附落，或绝灭无后，或引而远去。

translations.literal: Fifty-two strains declined and could not stand alone; they scattered as dependent camps or were extinguished without heirs or withdrew far away.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty-two weak strains dwindled into dependents, died out, or slipped beyond reach.

sentences.zh: 其八十九种，唯钟最强，胜兵十余万。

translations.literal: Of the eighty-nine strains only Zhong was strongest, with over one hundred thousand fit warriors.
translations.idiomatic: Among eighty-nine surviving names Zhong alone mustered six figures of spears.

sentences.zh: 其余大者万余人，小者数千人，更相抄盗，盛衰无常，无虑顺帝时胜兵合可二十万人。

translations.literal: The rest—the large over ten thousand, the small several thousand—raided one another in turn, rising and falling without constancy; reckoning roughly at Emperor Shun's time fit warriors combined near two hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Lesser bands ranged from thousands to tens of thousands; around Shun's reign total fighters approached two hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 发羌、唐旄等绝远，未尝往来。

translations.literal: Fa Qiang, Tangmao, and others were utterly distant and never came and went.
translations.idiomatic: Fa Qiang and Tangmao remained beyond Han contact.

sentences.zh: 氂牛、白马羌在蜀、汉，其种别名号，皆不可纪知也。

translations.literal: Yak and White Horse Qiang in Shu and Han—their branch titles cannot all be recorded and known.
translations.idiomatic: Yak and White Horse subtribes in the southwest bore too many labels to catalogue.

sentences.zh: 建武十三年，广汉塞外白马羌豪楼登等率种人五千余户内属，光武封楼登为归义君长。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Jianwu beyond Guanghan barrier White Horse Qiang chief Loudeng and others led over five thousand households to attach within; Guangwu enfeoffed Loudeng chief Who Returns to Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Jianwu 13: Loudeng delivered five thousand tents and earned Guangwu's patent of submission.

sentences.zh: 至和帝永元六年，蜀郡徼外大牂夷种羌豪造头等率种人五十余万口内属，拜造头为邑君长，赐印绶。

translations.literal: Down to Emperor He's Yongyuan sixth year beyond Shu Commandery great Yang Yi-strain Qiang chief Zaotou and others led over five hundred thousand mouths to attach within; Zaotou was appointed district chief with seals and ribbons.
translations.idiomatic: He's Yongyuan 6 saw Zaotou march half a million followers into Shu.

sentences.zh: 至安帝永初元年，蜀郡徼外羌龙桥等六种万七千二百八十口内属。

translations.literal: Down to Emperor An's Yongchu first year beyond Shu Commandery Qiang Longqiao and six other strains—seventeen thousand two hundred eighty mouths—attached within.
translations.idiomatic: An Di's Yongchu 1 added Longqiao's six allied bands.

sentences.zh: 明年，蜀郡徼外羌薄申等八种三万六千九百口复举土内属。

translations.literal: The next year beyond Shu Commandery Qiang Boshen and eight other strains—thirty-six thousand nine hundred mouths—again raised land and attached within.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Boshen's eight groups contributed thirty-seven thousand souls.

sentences.zh: 冬，广汉塞外参狼种羌二千四百口复来内属。

translations.literal: In winter beyond Guanghan barrier Canlang-strain Qiang twenty-four hundred mouths again came to attach within.
translations.idiomatic: Winter brought twenty-four hundred Canlang mouths from beyond Guanghan.

sentences.zh: 桓帝建和二年，白马羌千余人寇广汉属国，杀长吏，益州刺史率板楯蛮讨破之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianhe of Emperor Huan over a thousand White Horse Qiang raided Guanghan dependent state, killing senior clerks; Yizhou Inspector led Ban-shield barbarians defeating them.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Di Jianhe 2: shield infantry under the inspector broke another White Horse raid.

sentences.zh: 湟中月氏胡，其先大月氏之别也，旧在张掖、酒泉地。

translations.literal: Zhong Yuezhi Hu—their ancestors were a branch of Greater Yuezhi—formerly dwelt on Zhangye and Jiuquan ground.
translations.idiomatic: Little Yuezhi in Zhong stemmed from Greater Yuezhi stock once rooted in Hexi.

sentences.zh: 月氏王为匈奴冒顿所杀，余种分散，西逾葱领。

translations.literal: The Yuezhi king was killed by Xiongnu Modun; surviving kinds scattered, crossing Cong Ridge westward.
translations.idiomatic: Modun slew the Yuezhi king and drove survivors over the Pamirs.

sentences.zh: 其羸弱者南入山阻，依诸羌居止，遂与共婚姻。

translations.literal: The weak entered southern mountain defiles, relying on various Qiang dwelling, and thereupon intermarried with them.
translations.idiomatic: The feeble remnant sheltered with Qiang bands and intermarried.

sentences.zh: 及骠骑将军霍去病破匈奴，取西河地，开湟中，于是月氏来降，与汉人错居。

translations.literal: When Cavalry General Huo Qubing shattered Xiongnu, took Xihe lands, and opened Zhong, the Yuezhi then came to surrender, intermingling with Han.
translations.idiomatic: Huo Qubing's sweep opened Zhong and drew Little Yuezhi into Han towns.

sentences.zh: 虽依附县官，而首施两端。

translations.literal: Although they leaned on county officials they hesitated both ways.
translations.idiomatic: They bowed to magistrates yet hedged with the tribes.

sentences.zh: 其从汉兵战斗，随势强弱。

translations.literal: Those who followed Han troops in battle went with whichever side was stronger.
translations.idiomatic: Their spears followed whichever banner seemed ascendant.

sentences.zh: 被服饮食言语略与羌同，亦以父名母姓为种。

translations.literal: Clothing, food, drink, and speech broadly matched Qiang; they also took father's name and mother's surname as strain.
translations.idiomatic: They dressed, ate, and talked like Qiang and named clans from both parents.

sentences.zh: 其大种有七，胜兵合九千余人，分在湟中及令居。

translations.literal: Their great strains numbered seven, combining over nine thousand fit warriors distributed through Zhong and Lingju.
translations.idiomatic: Seven principal bands fielded nine thousand fighters around Zhong and Lingju.

sentences.zh: 又数百户在张掖，号曰义从胡。

translations.literal: Moreover several hundred households in Zhangye were styled Volunteer Hu.
translations.idiomatic: Hundreds more households in Zhangye were called Volunteer Hu.

sentences.zh: 中平元年，与北宫伯玉等反，杀护羌校尉泠征、金城太守陈懿，遂寇乱陇右焉。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhongping they rebelled with Beigong Boyu and others, killing Colonel Protecting Qiang Ling Zheng and Jincheng Governor Chen Yi; then they threw Longyou into turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongping volunteers slew Ling Zheng and Chen Yi and unraveled Longyou.

sentences.zh: 论曰：羌戎之患，自三代尚矣。

translations.literal: The discourse says: The calamity of Qiang and Rong has been grave since the Three Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: The historian opens by noting Qiang-Rong trouble runs back to high antiquity.

sentences.zh: 汉世方之匈奴，颇为衰寡，而中兴以后，边难渐大。

translations.literal: Compared to Xiongnu in Han times they were somewhat weaker and fewer, yet after the restoration border crises gradually grew.
translations.idiomatic: They seemed less fearsome than the Xiongnu yet grew deadlier after Guangwu.

sentences.zh: 朝规失绥御之和，戎师骞然诺之信。

translations.literal: Court regulations lost the harmony of soothing rule; Rong hosts lightly broke sworn faith.
translations.idiomatic: Policy turned harsh and frontier word proved brittle.

sentences.zh: 其内属者，或倥偬之豪右之手，或屈折于奴仆之勤。

translations.literal: Those who attached within fell sometimes into the hands of hustling magnates or bent under slaves' toil.
translations.idiomatic: Interior tribes fell prey to powerful houses and servile labor.

sentences.zh: 塞候时清，则愤怒而思祸；

translations.literal: When frontier beacons stayed clear they grew angry plotting disaster;
translations.idiomatic: Calm passes bred resentment and plots of violence.

sentences.zh: 桴革暂动，则属鞬以鸟惊。

translations.literal: when drums briefly stirred they strung bows like startled birds.
translations.idiomatic: The slightest rumor of war strung every bow.

sentences.zh: 故永初之间，群种蜂起。

translations.literal: Therefore between Yongchu years strains swarmed like hornets.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchu years saw tribes boil up everywhere.

sentences.zh: 遂解仇嫌，结盟诅，招引山豪，转相啸聚，揭木为兵，负柴为械。

translations.literal: They dropped old feuds, swore blood oaths, summoned mountain chiefs, gathered followings, hoisted wood as weapons and shouldered kindling as gear.
translations.idiomatic: Old hatreds gave way to joint oaths, mountain leagues, and clubs of firewood.

sentences.zh: 毂马扬埃，陆梁于三辅；

translations.literal: Hooves raised dust as they rampaged Three Assistants;
translations.idiomatic: Their horsemen raised dust as they rampaged through the Three Assistants.

sentences.zh: 建号称制，恣睢于北地。

translations.literal: they styled kings and issued orders lording it in Beidi.
translations.idiomatic: Would-be kings lorded over Beidi.

sentences.zh: 东犯赵、魏之郊，南入汉、蜀之鄙，塞湟中，断陇道，烧陵园，剽城市，伤败踵系，羽书日闻。

translations.literal: East they violated Zhao and Wei marches; south they entered Han and Shu borderlands; they blocked Zhong, severed Long roads, burned imperial parks, plundered cities—defeat followed defeat and feather dispatches arrived daily.
translations.idiomatic: They strangled Zhong, cut the Long corridor, fired imperial tombs, and filled the court with urgent mail.

sentences.zh: 并、凉之士，特冲残毙，壮悍则委身于兵场，女妇则徽纆而为虏，发冢露胔，死生涂炭。

translations.literal: Bing and Liang gentry met utter ruin; stalwart men died on battlefields while women bound with rope became captives; tombs opened exposing bones—life and death lay in ashes.
translations.idiomatic: Bing-Liang elites perished in arms or bonds while open graves littered the plateau.

sentences.zh: 自西戎作逆，未有陵斥上国若斯其炽也。

translations.literal: Since western Rong rebelled none had insulted the upper state as fiercely as this.
translations.idiomatic: No prior Rong rising had humbled the dynasty so badly.

sentences.zh: 和熹以女君亲政，威不外接。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager He Xi held court as female sovereign; awe did not reach beyond the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Regent He Xi kept authority closeted within the harem.

sentences.zh: 朝议惮兵力之损，情存苟安。

translations.literal: Court debate feared troop losses and clung to makeshift peace.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers dreaded casualties and chose drift.

sentences.zh: 或以边州难援，宜见捐弃；

translations.literal: Some held frontier provinces beyond rescue and fit to abandon;
translations.idiomatic: Some argued the northwest was expendable;

sentences.zh: 或惧疽食浸淫，莫知所限。

translations.literal: others dreaded ulcerous spread with no knowing its limit.
translations.idiomatic: Others feared gangrene without limit.

sentences.zh: 谋夫回遑，猛士疑虑，遂徙西河四郡之人，杂寓关右之县。

translations.literal: Counselors wavered and champions hesitated; they therefore moved west-of-river four-commandery people mixed into Guanxi counties.
translations.idiomatic: Hesitation relocated four northwest commands east of the passes.

sentences.zh: 发屋伐树，塞其恋土之心；

translations.literal: They tore down houses and felled trees to block longing for native soil;
translations.idiomatic: Officials tore down houses and cut orchards to sever ties to native soil.

sentences.zh: 燔破赀积，以防顾还之思。

translations.literal: they burned stores to prevent thoughts of return.
translations.idiomatic: They burned stocks of grain and goods to stamp out wishful thoughts of returning.

sentences.zh: 于是诸将邓骘、任尚、马贤、皇甫规、张奂之徒，争设雄规，更奉征讨之命，征兵会众，以图其隙。

translations.literal: Thereupon generals Deng Zhi, Ren Shang, Ma Xian, Huangfu Gui, Zhang Huan, and the like vied to lay grand plans, repeatedly receiving campaigning orders, mobilizing levies and masses to seek openings.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Zhi, Ren Shang, Ma Xian, Huangfu Gui, and Zhang Huan chased openings with grand strategies.

sentences.zh: 驰骋东西，奔救首尾，摇动数州之境，日耗千金之资。

translations.literal: They galloped east and west, racing to save head and tail, shaking several provinces, costing a thousand in gold daily.
translations.idiomatic: Armies dashed between fronts burning treasure by the day.

sentences.zh: 至于假人增赋，借奉侯王，引金钱缣彩之珍，征粮粟盐铁之积。

translations.literal: They reached the point of levying others' taxes, borrowing princes' incomes, drawing gold, silk, and colored gems, requisitioning grain, millet, salt, and iron stores.
